REPAIR (run 40153908549, operational resume of producer run 40153096228): the two nested disclosure helpers c3_ok_check / c4_ok_check were DEFINED AFTER their call site, so the committed instrument raised UnboundLocalError at fast_mvp_retrieval_recall_benchmark.py:689 and could not re-derive its own committed record. No frozen predicate, k, population, ground-truth set, control definition, success rule, verdict vocabulary or claim ceiling changed; the hypothesis file stays byte-identical to its freeze pin.

claim_ceiling: One relative, non-calibrated claim: on these 24 cached OpenCaseLaw cells, with these frozen id sets at k=20, the product reranker does or does not lose ground-truth authorities that its own input order kept. It does not claim absolute retrieval quality, any bar met, serving readiness, human_gate_ready (stays false), jurist utility, calibrated uncertainty, answer correctness, or any property of live network retrieval (network_calls=0). Coverage limitation is part of the claim: a PASS means 'no loss observed on the discriminating cells', never 'retrieval works'. Corpus docs use gates.row_text (title+regeste+snippet), not the product's production full_text pipeline; the corpus is the per-cell OCL response, not the product's unioned deduped pipeline.
